answer: Agents bond stake in a vault and commit to an epoch polynomial whose evaluations encode shares of a secret. Semaphore-style proofs verify membership without exposing identity, while RLN nullifiers enforce one message per rate-limit interval. Reusing a nullifier yields distinct shares; interpolation exposes the private key, triggering immediate collateral slashing. This makes each identity an island of accountable participation, not a gale of disposable Sybils.
